description: A week-strip calendar control for Uno Platform, styled after the Control Gallery "Horizontal Calendar" sheet: seven days in a white card with a cobalt pill that slides 380 ms between days, a navy ring on today, one tick per event (up to four) and hatched unavailable days that are focusable but not selectable. The strip pages a week at a time (460 ms slide) and the selected day's agenda sits below it, with Ready, empty-day, Loading (skeleton rows that hold their height) and Error (Retry) states. ← → move a day, PgUp / PgDn a week and T jumps to today. Under 600 px the control switches to its phone layout with a docked Add event button. Schibsted Grotesk and Azeret Mono are bundled; Light is the sheet's palette and Dark keeps the navy and cobalt identity.

showcase.summary: A week strip with a sliding selection pill, busy ticks, unavailable days and the day's agenda with loading and error states.
goals: A templated control whose default style carries the design: tokens in Light and Default theme dictionaries, bundled static fonts
A three-week panel that slides between weeks and a pill that slides between days, both on KeySpline 0.3,0.7 0.2,1
Agenda states as VisualStates (Events, Empty, Loading, Error) driven by an AgendaState property, with RetryRequested
Unavailable days from an UnavailableDays map: hatched, struck through, focusable, never selected
Keyboard (← →, PgUp, PgDn, T), named days and buttons, a polite live week range and an assertive error
A compact phone layout chosen from the control's own width (DisplayMode Auto)
Hot Design previews of each state, a runtime Light/Dark switch and {utu:Responsive} on the host page
